name: DrawKit · Transport & Travel Illustrations

title.zh: DrawKit · 先比素材风格再核具体包条件

description.zh: 进具体包查看原预览与取用条件。 插画与图标资源入口，按二维、三维等类型浏览素材包，具体页面列出预览、文件格式及取用方式。Transport & Travel为已核免费包，Pro为付费方案；许可允许合规最终作品，禁止素材再分发、可下载模板、含素材拷贝的商品及AI/ML训练，制作程序源码未知。
description.en: An illustration and icon entry with 2D and 3D collections, original previews, formats and access information. Transport & Travel is a verified free pack, while Pro is paid. Its custom license permits compliant final works but prohibits asset redistribution, downloadable templates, merchandise containing asset copies, and AI/ML training. Program production source is unknown.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by DrawKit (https://www.drawkit.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 进具体包查看原预览与取用条件。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先看首页的立体人物封面，再到二维目录比较双人线描、时间主题和等距场景，三张包卡都已加载。具体包详情展示两人野餐插画与SVG、PNG、邮箱下载入口，本次未搜索、提交邮箱、下载或验包。免费包和Pro卡分开核价；许可允许合规最终作品，但禁素材再分发、可下载模板、含素材拷贝的商品及AI/ML训练。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
